acceptedAnswer.text: To make a home addition energy efficient, focus on incorporating key elements during the design and construction phases. This includes using high-quality insulation in walls, ceilings, and floors, selecting energy-efficient windows and doors (such as double-pane or low-e glass), and choosing ENERGY STAR-rated appliances. Integrating passive solar design principles, such as proper window orientation for natural light and ventilation, can also reduce energy consumption. Additionally, consider sustainable roofing materials and potentially installing solar panels to offset electricity usage, further enhancing long-term energy savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make your home addition energy efficient by using high-quality insulation, energy-efficient windows/doors, ENERGY STAR appliances, and passive solar design principles.
